title: The Book of Matthew Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Matthew — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
verses.decoded: This is the record of the ancestry of Jesus Christ, who is a descendant of David and Abraham.

verses.kjv: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his brethren;
verses.decoded: Abraham fathered Isaac; Isaac fathered Jacob; and Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.

verses.kjv: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
verses.decoded: Judah fathered Perez and Zerah by Tamar; Perez fathered Hezron; and Hezron fathered Ram.

verses.kjv: And Aram begat Aminadab; and Aminadab begat Naasson; and Naasson begat Salmon;
verses.decoded: Ram fathered Amminadab; Amminadab fathered Nahshon; and Nahshon fathered Salmon.

verses.kjv: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
verses.decoded: Salmon fathered Boaz by Rahab; Boaz fathered Obed by Ruth; and Obed fathered Jesse.

verses.kjv: And Jesse begat David the king; and David the king begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Urias;
verses.decoded: Jesse fathered King David; and King David fathered Solomon by the woman who had been Uriah's wife.

verses.kjv: And Solomon begat Roboam; and Roboam begat Abia; and Abia begat Asa;
verses.decoded: Solomon fathered Rehoboam; Rehoboam fathered Abijah; and Abijah fathered Asa.

verses.kjv: And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;
verses.decoded: Asa fathered Jehoshaphat; Jehoshaphat fathered Joram; and Joram fathered Uzziah.

verses.kjv: And Ozias begat Joatham; and Joatham begat Achaz; and Achaz begat Ezekias;
verses.decoded: Uzziah fathered Jotham; Jotham fathered Ahaz; and Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.

verses.kjv: And Ezekias begat Manasses; and Manasses begat Amon; and Amon begat Josias;
verses.decoded: Hezekiah fathered Manasseh; Manasseh fathered Amon; and Amon fathered Josiah.

verses.kjv: And Josias begat Jechonias and his brethren, about the time they were carried away to Babylon:
verses.decoded: Josiah fathered Jeconiah and his brothers around the time they were taken into exile in Babylon.

verses.kjv: And after they were brought to Babylon, Jechonias begat Salathiel; and Salathiel begat Zorobabel;
verses.decoded: After the exile in Babylon, Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel; and Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.

verses.kjv: And Zorobabel begat Abiud; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;
verses.decoded: Zerubbabel fathered Abiud; Abiud fathered Eliakim; and Eliakim fathered Azor.

verses.kjv: And Azor begat Sadoc; and Sadoc begat Achim; and Achim begat Eliud;
verses.decoded: Azor fathered Zadok; Zadok fathered Akim; and Akim fathered Eliud.

verses.kjv: And Eliud begat Eleazar; and Eleazar begat Matthan; and Matthan begat Jacob;
verses.decoded: Eliud fathered Eleazar; Eleazar fathered Matthan; and Matthan fathered Jacob.

verses.kjv: And Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.
verses.decoded: Jacob was the father of Joseph, who was married to Mary, and Jesus was born to her. Jesus is called the Messiah.

verses.kjv: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David until the carrying away into Babylon are fourteen generations; and from the carrying away into Babylon unto Christ are fourteen generations.
verses.decoded: There are fourteen generations from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile in Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to Christ.

verses.kjv: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as his mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: This is how Jesus Christ was born: Mary, who was engaged to Joseph, was found to be pregnant by the Holy Spirit before they lived together.

verses.kjv: Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a publick example, was minded to put her away privily.
verses.decoded: Joseph, a righteous man, did not want to disgrace Mary publicly, so he planned to quietly end their engagement.

verses.kjv: But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the LORD appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Ghost.
verses.decoded: While Joseph was considering this, an angel appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph, descendant of David, don't be afraid to marry Mary, because her child was conceived by the Holy Spirit.'

verses.kjv: And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
verses.decoded: Mary will have a son, and you must name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.

verses.kjv: Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying,
verses.decoded: All this happened to fulfill what the Lord had spoken through the prophet,

verses.kjv: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.
verses.decoded: A virgin will become pregnant and give birth to a son, and he will be called Emmanuel, which means 'God is with us.'

verses.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
verses.decoded: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel commanded and took Mary as his wife.

verses.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
verses.decoded: He did not have marital relations with her until she gave birth to her first son, and he named him Jesus.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judaea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,
verses.decoded: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea, during King Herod's reign, some wise men from the east arrived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Saying, Where is he that is born King of the Jews? for we have seen his star in the east, and are come to worship him.
verses.decoded: They asked, 'Where is the newborn King of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.'

verses.kjv: When Herod the king had heard these things, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
verses.decoded: When King Herod heard this, he was disturbed, and the whole city of Jerusalem was upset too.

verses.kjv: And when he had gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people together, he demanded of them where Christ should be born.
verses.decoded: Herod called together the leading priests and teachers and asked them where the Messiah was supposed to be born.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, In Bethlehem of Judaea: for thus it is written by the prophet,
verses.decoded: They answered, 'In Bethlehem of Judea, because the prophet wrote this.'

verses.kjv: And thou Bethlehem, in the land of Juda, art not the least among the princes of Juda: for out of thee shall come a Governor, that shall rule my people Israel.
verses.decoded: 'Bethlehem, in Judah, you are not the least important town among Judah’s leaders, because a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel will come from you.'

verses.kjv: Then Herod, when he had privily called the wise men, enquired of them diligently what time the star appeared.
verses.decoded: Herod secretly called the wise men and carefully asked them when the star first appeared.

verses.kjv: And he sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child; and when ye have found him, bring me word again, that I may come and worship him also.
verses.decoded: He sent them to Bethlehem saying, 'Go and search carefully for the child. When you find him, let me know so I can come and worship him too.'

verses.kjv: When they had heard the king, they departed; and, lo, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, till it came and stood over where the young child was.
verses.decoded: After hearing the king, they left, and the star they had seen in the east led them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

verses.kjv: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.decoded: When they saw the star, they were filled with overwhelming joy.

verses.kjv: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.
verses.decoded: They entered the house, saw the child with his mother Mary, bowed down and worshiped him, then gave him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

verses.kjv: And being warned of God in a dream that they should not return to Herod, they departed into their own country another way.
verses.decoded: God warned them in a dream not to go back to Herod, so they returned to their country by a different route.

verses.kjv: And when they were departed, behold, the angel of the Lord appeareth to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.
verses.decoded: After the Magi left, an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, 'Get up, take the child and his mother, and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you to come back, because Herod wants to kill the child.'

verses.kjv: When he arose, he took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt:
verses.decoded: Joseph got up, took the child and his mother during the night, and left for Egypt.

verses.kjv: And was there until the death of Herod: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt have I called my son.
verses.decoded: They stayed in Egypt until Herod died, fulfilling what the Lord had spoken through the prophet: 'I called my son out of Egypt.'

verses.kjv: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked of the wise men, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth, and slew all the children that were in Bethlehem, and in all the coasts thereof, from two years old and under, according to the time which he had diligently enquired of the wise men.
verses.decoded: This fulfilled what the prophet Jeremiah had said,

verses.kjv: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying,
verses.decoded: A voice was heard in Ramah—crying, weeping, and great sorrow. Rachel was weeping for her children and refused to be comforted because they were gone.

verses.kjv: In Rama was there a voice heard, lamentation, and weeping, and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children, and would not be comforted, because they are not.
verses.decoded: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream while he was in Egypt,

verses.kjv: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeareth in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,
verses.decoded: and said, 'Get up, take the child and his mother, and return to Israel, because those who wanted to kill the child are dead.'

verses.kjv: Saying, Arise, and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: for they are dead which sought the young child’s life.
verses.decoded: So Joseph got up, took the child and his mother, and went back to Israel.

verses.kjv: And he arose, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.
verses.decoded: But when he learned that Archelaus was ruling Judea instead of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. After being warned by God in a dream, he went to the region of Galilee instead.

verses.kjv: But when he heard that Archelaus did reign in Judaea in the room of his father Herod, he was afraid to go thither: notwithstanding, being warned of God in a dream, he turned aside into the parts of Galilee:
verses.decoded: He went and lived in a town called Nazareth, fulfilling what the prophets said—that he would be called a Nazarene.

verses.kjv: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
verses.decoded: At that time, John the Baptist appeared, preaching in the wilderness of Judea.

verses.kjv: And saying, Repent ye: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Turn away from your sins, because the kingdom of heaven is near.'

verses.kjv: For this is he that was spoken of by the prophet Esaias, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
verses.decoded: This is the one the prophet Isaiah spoke about: 'A voice shouting in the wilderness, Prepare the way for the Lord; make his paths straight.'

verses.kjv: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.
verses.decoded: John wore clothes made of camel's hair with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.

verses.kjv: Then went out to him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about Jordan,
verses.decoded: People from Jerusalem, all Judea, and the surrounding Jordan area went out to him.

verses.kjv: And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.
verses.decoded: They were baptized by him in the Jordan River, confessing their sins.

verses.kjv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism, he said unto them, O generation of vipers, who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
verses.decoded: When John saw many Pharisees and Sadducees coming to be baptized, he said to them, 'You snakes! Who warned you to escape the coming judgment?'

verses.kjv: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
verses.decoded: Produce actions that show you have truly turned from sin.

verses.kjv: And think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
verses.decoded: Don’t think you can rely on being Abraham’s descendants; God can raise up children for Abraham even from these stones.

verses.kjv: And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: therefore every tree which bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.decoded: The axe is already ready to cut down every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit; such trees are cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire:
verses.decoded: I baptize you with water to show repentance, but someone stronger than me is coming. I’m not even worthy to carry his sandals. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.

verses.kjv: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
verses.decoded: He holds a winnowing fan in his hand and will clean his threshing floor, gathering the wheat into his barn but burning the chaff with unquenchable fire.

verses.kjv: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.

verses.kjv: But John forbad him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
verses.decoded: But John tried to stop him, saying, 'I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Let it be so now; it is proper for us to do this to fulfill all righteousness.' Then John agreed.

verses.kjv: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:
verses.decoded: As soon as Jesus was baptized, he came up out of the water. At that moment, the heavens opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and resting on him.

verses.kjv: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.decoded: Then a voice from heaven said, 'This is my beloved Son, and I am very pleased with him.'

verses.kjv: Then was Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
verses.decoded: Then the Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

verses.kjv: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
verses.decoded: After fasting for forty days and forty nights, Jesus was very hungry.

verses.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
verses.decoded: The tempter came to him and said, 'If you are the Son of God, turn these stones into bread.'

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'It is written: People do not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from God.'

verses.kjv: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
verses.decoded: Then the devil took Jesus to the holy city and set him on the highest point of the temple.

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.
verses.decoded: He said to him, 'If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, because it is written that God will command his angels to protect you, so you won’t hurt your foot on a stone.'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, It is written again, Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'It also says, You must not put the Lord your God to the test.'

verses.kjv: Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them;
verses.decoded: Then the devil took him to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

verses.kjv: And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.
verses.decoded: He said, 'I will give you all these things if you will bow down and worship me.'

verses.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God, and him only shalt thou serve.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to him, 'Go away, Satan! For it is written, You must worship the Lord your God and serve only him.'

verses.kjv: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, angels came and ministered unto him.
verses.decoded: Then the devil left him, and angels came and took care of him.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison, he departed into Galilee;
verses.decoded: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.

verses.kjv: And leaving Nazareth, he came and dwelt in Capernaum, which is upon the sea coast, in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim:
verses.decoded: Leaving Nazareth, Jesus went to live in Capernaum, a town by the sea near the regions of Zebulun and Naphtali.

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying,
verses.decoded: This happened to fulfill what the prophet Isaiah had spoken:

verses.kjv: The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles;
verses.decoded: ‘Land of Zebulun and land of Naphtali, by the sea, beyond the Jordan—Galilee of the Gentiles.’

verses.kjv: The people which sat in darkness saw great light; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up.
verses.decoded: The people living in darkness have seen a great light; those living in the land of deep darkness have seen a bright light.

verses.kjv: From that time Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.decoded: From that moment, Jesus started preaching, saying, 'Turn away from your sins, because the kingdom of heaven is near.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus, walking by the sea of Galilee, saw two brethren, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother, casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
verses.decoded: As Jesus walked along the Sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon (called Peter) and his brother Andrew, throwing a net into the water because they were fishermen.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'Come, follow me, and I will teach you how to catch people instead of fish.'

verses.kjv: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
verses.decoded: Immediately, they left their nets behind and followed him.

verses.kjv: And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.
verses.decoded: Going a little further, Jesus saw two other brothers, James and John, sons of Zebedee, in a boat with their father, fixing their fishing nets. Jesus called them.

verses.kjv: And they immediately left the ship and their father, and followed him.
verses.decoded: Right away, they left the boat and their father and followed Jesus.

verses.kjv: And Jesus went about all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease among the people.
verses.decoded: Jesus traveled throughout Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news about God's kingdom, and healing all kinds of sickness and disease among the people.

verses.kjv: And his fame went throughout all Syria: and they brought unto him all sick people that were taken with divers diseases and torments, and those which were possessed with devils, and those which were lunatick, and those that had the palsy; and he healed them.
verses.decoded: News about him spread throughout all Syria, and people brought to him all who were sick with various diseases and painful conditions, those possessed by demons, those suffering from seizures, and those paralyzed; and he healed them all.

verses.kjv: And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee, and from Decapolis, and from Jerusalem, and from Judaea, and from beyond Jordan.
verses.decoded: Large crowds from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and the area beyond the Jordan River followed him.

verses.kjv: And seeing the multitudes, he went up into a mountain: and when he was set, his disciples came unto him:
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on a mountain. After he sat down, his disciples came to him.

verses.kjv: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
verses.decoded: He began to speak and taught them, saying,

verses.kjv: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who recognize their spiritual need, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who are sad and grieving, because they will be comforted.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
verses.decoded: Happy are the gentle and humble, because they will receive the earth as their inheritance.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who deeply desire to live rightly, because they will be satisfied.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who show kindness and forgiveness, because they will receive mercy.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.
verses.decoded: Happy are those with sincere and clean hearts, because they will see God.

verses.kjv: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who work to make peace, because they will be recognized as God’s children.

verses.kjv: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: Happy are those who suffer because they do what is right, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to them.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.
verses.decoded: You are happy when people insult you, persecute you, and lie about you because of me.

verses.kjv: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.
verses.decoded: Be joyful and glad, because your reward in heaven is great. The prophets were persecuted in the same way.

verses.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verses.decoded: You are like salt for the world. But if salt loses its flavor, how can it be made salty again? It becomes useless and is thrown away.

verses.kjv: Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
verses.decoded: You are like light for the world. A city built on a hill cannot be hidden.

verses.kjv: Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house.
verses.decoded: People don’t light a lamp and then hide it under a basket, but put it on a stand so it gives light to everyone in the house.

verses.kjv: Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: Let your good deeds shine brightly before others, so they will see them and praise your Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.
verses.decoded: Don’t think I came to abolish the law or the prophets; I came to complete their purpose.

verses.kjv: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Truly, until heaven and earth disappear, not even the smallest letter or stroke will disappear from the law until everything is accomplished.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: Anyone who breaks even the smallest command and teaches others to do so will be least in God’s kingdom; but those who obey and teach the commandments will be called great.

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: I tell you, unless your righteousness is better than that of the religious leaders, you will never enter God’s kingdom.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:
verses.decoded: You have heard the old command, ‘Do not murder,’ and that anyone who murders will face judgment.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.
verses.decoded: But I say, anyone who is angry with a brother without reason will face judgment; anyone who insults a brother by calling him ‘Raca’ will face the council; and anyone who calls him ‘fool’ will be in danger of hellfire.

verses.kjv: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar, and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee;
verses.decoded: So if you bring your offering to the altar and remember that your brother has something against you,

verses.kjv: Leave there thy gift before the altar, and go thy way; first be reconciled to thy brother, and then come and offer thy gift.
verses.decoded: Leave your gift there, go and make peace with your brother first, then come back and offer your gift.

verses.kjv: Agree with thine adversary quickly, whiles thou art in the way with him; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and thou be cast into prison.
verses.decoded: Make peace quickly with your opponent while you are still on the way, or else your opponent may hand you over to the judge, who will hand you over to the officer, and you will be thrown into prison.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, you will not get out until you have paid every last penny.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not commit adultery:
verses.decoded: You have heard the command from long ago: ‘Do not commit adultery.’

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.
verses.decoded: But I say, anyone who looks at a woman lustfully has already committed adultery with her in his heart.

verses.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.decoded: If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away. It’s better to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.

verses.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.
verses.decoded: If your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It’s better to lose one part than for your whole body to be sent to hell.

verses.kjv: It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:
verses.decoded: It has been said that anyone who divorces his wife must give her a written certificate of divorce.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That whosoever shall put away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causeth her to commit adultery: and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery.
verses.decoded: But I tell you, anyone who divorces his wife except for sexual immorality causes her to commit adultery, and anyone who marries a divorced woman also commits adultery.

verses.kjv: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:
verses.decoded: You have also heard that in the past it was said, 'Do not break your oath, but keep the promises you make to the Lord.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is God’s throne:
verses.decoded: But I tell you, do not swear at all—not by heaven, because it is God's throne.

verses.kjv: Nor by the earth; for it is his footstool: neither by Jerusalem; for it is the city of the great King.
verses.decoded: Do not swear by the earth, because it is His footstool, or by Jerusalem, because it is the city of the great King.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou swear by thy head, because thou canst not make one hair white or black.
verses.decoded: Do not swear by your own head, since you cannot make even one hair white or black.

verses.kjv: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.
verses.decoded: Simply say 'Yes' or 'No'; anything beyond this comes from evil.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:
verses.decoded: You have heard the law that says, 'Eye for eye, and tooth for tooth.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, That ye resist not evil: but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek, turn to him the other also.
verses.decoded: But I tell you, do not resist an evil person. If someone strikes you on the right cheek, turn to them the other cheek also.

verses.kjv: And if any man will sue thee at the law, and take away thy coat, let him have thy cloak also.
verses.decoded: If someone sues you to take your shirt, give them your coat as well.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
verses.decoded: If someone forces you to go one mile, go with them two miles.

verses.kjv: Give to him that asketh thee, and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away.
verses.decoded: Give to anyone who asks you, and don’t refuse someone who wants to borrow from you.

verses.kjv: Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.
verses.decoded: You have heard that it was said, 'Love your neighbor and hate your enemy.'

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;
verses.decoded: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat and persecute you.

verses.kjv: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven: for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good, and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust.
verses.decoded: In doing this, you will be children of your Father in heaven, who causes the sun to rise on both the evil and the good, and sends rain on both the righteous and the unrighteous.

verses.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what reward have ye? do not even the publicans the same?
verses.decoded: If you only love those who love you, what reward is there? Even tax collectors do that.

verses.kjv: And if ye salute your brethren only, what do ye more than others? do not even the publicans so?
verses.decoded: And if you only greet your own people, what are you doing more than others? Even tax collectors do that.

verses.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
verses.decoded: So be perfect, just as your heavenly Father is perfect.

verses.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: Be careful not to give to the needy just to be noticed by others; if you do, you won't receive any reward from your Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: Therefore when thou doest thine alms, do not sound a trumpet before thee, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may have glory of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.decoded: So when you give to the needy, don’t announce it loudly like hypocrites do in synagogues and on the streets to get praise from others. They have already received their reward.

verses.kjv: But when thou doest alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth:
verses.decoded: When you give to the needy, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand is doing.

verses.kjv: That thine alms may be in secret: and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly.
verses.decoded: Give in secret, and your Father, who sees what is done privately, will reward you openly.

verses.kjv: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.decoded: When you pray, don’t be like hypocrites who love to pray standing in synagogues and street corners just to be seen by others. They have already received their reward.

verses.kjv: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verses.decoded: Instead, when you pray, go into a private room, close the door, and pray to your Father who is unseen. He will reward you openly.

verses.kjv: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verses.decoded: When you pray, don’t repeat meaningless phrases over and over like pagans do, thinking that many words will make God listen.

verses.kjv: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
verses.decoded: Don’t be like them, because your Father already knows what you need before you ask Him.

verses.kjv: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
verses.decoded: Pray like this: Our Father in heaven, may your name be honored as holy.

verses.kjv: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verses.decoded: May your kingdom come, and may your will be done on earth just as it is in heaven.

verses.kjv: Give us this day our daily bread.
verses.decoded: Give us today the food we need.

verses.kjv: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
verses.decoded: Forgive us our sins, just as we forgive those who sin against us.

verses.kjv: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: Don’t let us be led into temptation, but protect us from evil. For yours is the kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
verses.decoded: If you forgive others for their wrongs, your Father in heaven will forgive you too.

verses.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
verses.decoded: But if you don’t forgive others, your Father won’t forgive your sins.

verses.kjv: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
verses.decoded: When you fast, don’t look gloomy like the hypocrites do. They make their faces look sad so people will see they are fasting. I tell you the truth, they have already received their reward.

verses.kjv: But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;
verses.decoded: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,

verses.kjv: That thou appear not unto men to fast, but unto thy Father which is in secret: and thy Father, which seeth in secret, shall reward thee openly.
verses.decoded: so you don’t show others that you are fasting, but only your Father who is unseen. And your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you openly.

verses.kjv: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
verses.decoded: Don’t store up treasures for yourselves here on earth, where moths and rust destroy, and where thieves break in and steal.

verses.kjv: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:
verses.decoded: But store up treasures for yourselves in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy, and thieves cannot break in and steal.

verses.kjv: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.decoded: Because wherever your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

verses.kjv: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.
verses.decoded: The eye is the lamp of the body. If your eye is healthy and focused, your whole body will be full of light.

verses.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!
verses.decoded: But if your eye is unhealthy or evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If the light inside you is actually darkness, how deep that darkness is!

verses.kjv: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon.
verses.decoded: No one can serve two masters. They will either hate one and love the other, or be loyal to one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.

verses.kjv: Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink; nor yet for your body, what ye shall put on. Is not the life more than meat, and the body than raiment?
verses.decoded: So I tell you, don’t worry about your life—what you will eat or drink—or about your body—what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothes?

verses.kjv: Behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns; yet your heavenly Father feedeth them. Are ye not much better than they?
verses.decoded: Look at the birds in the sky. They don’t plant or harvest or store food in barns, but your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you much more valuable than they are?

verses.kjv: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?
verses.decoded: Who of you by worrying can add even one foot to your height?

verses.kjv: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
verses.decoded: And why do you worry about clothes? Look at the lilies in the field—they don’t work or make their clothes by spinning thread.

verses.kjv: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.decoded: But I tell you, even King Solomon in all his splendor was not dressed like one of these lilies.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.decoded: If God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and thrown into the fire tomorrow, won’t He much more clothe you, you people of little faith?

verses.kjv: Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?
verses.decoded: So don’t worry and ask, ‘What will we eat?’ or ‘What will we drink?’ or ‘What clothes will we wear?’

verses.kjv: (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.
verses.decoded: People who don’t know God focus on these things, but your Father in heaven knows you need them.

verses.kjv: But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.decoded: Instead, put God’s kingdom and doing what is right first, and everything else you need will be given to you.

verses.kjv: Take therefore no thought for the morrow: for the morrow shall take thought for the things of itself. Sufficient unto the day is the evil thereof.
verses.decoded: So don’t worry about tomorrow; each day has enough trouble of its own.

verses.kjv: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
verses.decoded: Don't judge others, so that you won't be judged yourselves.

verses.kjv: For with what judgment ye judge, ye shall be judged: and with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you again.
verses.decoded: The way you judge others is the way you will be judged; the standard you use will be used for you.

verses.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.decoded: Why do you notice the tiny speck in your brother's eye but ignore the huge plank in your own eye?

verses.kjv: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?
verses.decoded: How can you say to your brother, 'Let me take the speck out of your eye,' when you have a plank in your own eye?

verses.kjv: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.
verses.decoded: You hypocrite, first remove the plank from your own eye, then you will clearly see to remove the speck from your brother's eye.

verses.kjv: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.
verses.decoded: Don't give what is sacred to those who won't appreciate it, like throwing pearls to pigs—they will trample them and attack you.

verses.kjv: Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:
verses.decoded: Ask, and you will receive; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

verses.kjv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
verses.decoded: Everyone who asks receives; those who seek find; and to those who knock, the door will be opened.

verses.kjv: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?
verses.decoded: Which of you, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone instead?

verses.kjv: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
verses.decoded: Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a snake?

verses.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verses.decoded: If you, despite your flaws, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

verses.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
verses.decoded: So in everything, treat others the way you want to be treated. This sums up the teachings of the law and the prophets.

verses.kjv: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:
verses.decoded: Enter through the narrow gate, because the gate is wide and the road broad that leads to destruction, and many take that path.

verses.kjv: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.
verses.decoded: Because the gate is narrow and the road is hard that leads to life, and only a few find it.

verses.kjv: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
verses.decoded: Watch out for false teachers who come disguised as harmless sheep but are actually dangerous wolves.

verses.kjv: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
verses.decoded: You will recognize people by what they produce. Do people pick grapes from thorn bushes or figs from weeds?

verses.kjv: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.
verses.decoded: In the same way, a good tree produces good fruit, but a bad tree produces bad fruit.

verses.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.decoded: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.

verses.kjv: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
verses.decoded: Every tree that does not produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

verses.kjv: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
verses.decoded: So, you will recognize people by what they produce.

verses.kjv: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: Not everyone who calls me 'Lord, Lord' will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only those who do what my Father in heaven wants.

verses.kjv: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?
verses.decoded: On that day, many will say to me, 'Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name? Didn’t we cast out demons and do many miracles in your name?'

verses.kjv: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.
verses.decoded: But I will tell them, 'I never knew you. Away from me, you who do wrong.'

verses.kjv: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:
verses.decoded: So, everyone who hears my words and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on solid rock.

verses.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.decoded: When the rain came, the floods rose, and the winds blew against that house, it did not fall because it was built on rock.

verses.kjv: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:
verses.decoded: But anyone who hears my words and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand.

verses.kjv: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell: and great was the fall of it.
verses.decoded: The rain came down, the floods rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it collapsed completely.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
verses.decoded: When Jesus finished speaking, the people were amazed at his teaching.

verses.kjv: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.
verses.decoded: He taught with authority, unlike the teachers of the law.

verses.kjv: When he was come down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.
verses.decoded: After Jesus came down from the mountain, large crowds followed him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a leper and worshipped him, saying, Lord, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
verses.decoded: A man with leprosy came to Jesus, knelt before him, and said, 'Lord, if you are willing, you can heal me.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will; be thou clean. And immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
verses.decoded: Jesus reached out, touched the man, and said, 'I am willing; be healed.' Immediately, the man was cured of his leprosy.

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, See thou tell no man; but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him not to tell anyone, but to go show himself to the priest and offer the required sacrifice, as Moses commanded, to prove he was healed.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum, there came unto him a centurion, beseeching him,
verses.decoded: When Jesus entered Capernaum, a Roman officer came to him, begging for help.

verses.kjv: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Lord, my servant is at home paralyzed and suffering terribly.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I will come and heal him.'

verses.kjv: The centurion answered and said, Lord, I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof: but speak the word only, and my servant shall be healed.
verses.decoded: The centurion replied, 'Lord, I am not worthy to have you come into my home, but just say the word, and my servant will be healed.'

verses.kjv: For I am a man under authority, having soldiers under me: and I say to this man, Go, and he goeth; and to another, Come, and he cometh; and to my servant, Do this, and he doeth it.
verses.decoded: He explained, 'I am under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go and he goes, tell another to come and he comes, and I tell my servant to do something and he does it.'

verses.kjv: When Jesus heard it, he marvelled, and said to them that followed, Verily I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel.
verses.decoded: When Jesus heard this, he was amazed and said to those following him, 'I tell you the truth, I have not found anyone in Israel with such great faith.'

verses.kjv: And I say unto you, That many shall come from the east and west, and shall sit down with Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Many will come from the east and west and will join Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.'

verses.kjv: But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.decoded: But those who were expected to belong to the kingdom will be thrown out into darkness, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto the centurion, Go thy way; and as thou hast believed, so be it done unto thee. And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour.
verses.decoded: Jesus told the centurion, 'Go. Because you believed, it will happen.' And the servant was healed at that very moment.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus was come into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother laid, and sick of a fever.
verses.decoded: When Jesus entered Peter’s house, he saw Peter’s mother-in-law lying sick with a fever.

verses.kjv: And he touched her hand, and the fever left her: and she arose, and ministered unto them.
verses.decoded: Jesus touched her hand, the fever left her, and she got up and began to serve them.

verses.kjv: When the even was come, they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils: and he cast out the spirits with his word, and healed all that were sick:
verses.decoded: When evening came, many people who were possessed by demons were brought to Jesus. He commanded the spirits to leave with just a word, and he healed all who were sick.

verses.kjv: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet, saying, Himself took our infirmities, and bare our sicknesses.
verses.decoded: This happened to fulfill what the prophet Isaiah said: 'He took our weaknesses and carried our diseases.'

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him, he gave commandment to depart unto the other side.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw large crowds around him, he told his disciples to go ahead to the other side of the lake.

verses.kjv: And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
verses.decoded: A teacher of the law came to Jesus and said, 'Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to rest his head.'

verses.kjv: And another of his disciples said unto him, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
verses.decoded: Another disciple said to Jesus, 'Lord, let me first go and bury my father.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus said unto him, Follow me; and let the dead bury their dead.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him, 'Follow me, and let those who are spiritually dead take care of burying their dead.'

verses.kjv: And when he was entered into a ship, his disciples followed him.
verses.decoded: Jesus got into a boat, and his disciples followed him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there arose a great tempest in the sea, insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves: but he was asleep.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a fierce storm came up on the sea, so strong that the waves covered the boat, but Jesus was sleeping.

verses.kjv: And his disciples came to him, and awoke him, saying, Lord, save us: we perish.
verses.decoded: The disciples woke him and said, 'Lord, save us! We’re going to drown!'

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Why are ye fearful, O ye of little faith? Then he arose, and rebuked the winds and the sea; and there was a great calm.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked, 'Why are you afraid, you people with so little faith?' Then he stood up and commanded the wind and the sea to be still, and there was complete calm.

verses.kjv: But the men marvelled, saying, What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!
verses.decoded: The disciples were amazed and said, 'What kind of man is this? Even the wind and the sea obey him!'

verses.kjv: And when he was come to the other side into the country of the Gergesenes, there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.
verses.decoded: When Jesus arrived on the other side, in the region of the Gadarenes, two demon-possessed men came out of the tombs. They were so violent that no one could pass that way.

verses.kjv: And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?
verses.decoded: They shouted, 'What do you want with us, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torture us before the appointed time?'

verses.kjv: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
verses.decoded: Some distance away, there was a large herd of pigs feeding.

verses.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.
verses.decoded: The demons begged Jesus, saying, 'If you drive us out, please let us enter the group of pigs.'

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Go. And when they were come out, they went into the herd of swine: and, behold, the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'Go.' When the demons left the man, they entered the pigs, and the entire herd rushed down a steep hill into the sea and drowned.

verses.kjv: And they that kept them fled, and went their ways into the city, and told every thing, and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils.
verses.decoded: The pig herders ran away and went into the town, telling everyone what had happened to the man possessed by demons.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the whole city came out to meet Jesus: and when they saw him, they besought him that he would depart out of their coasts.
verses.decoded: The entire town came out to meet Jesus, and when they saw him, they begged him to leave their region.

verses.kjv: And he entered into a ship, and passed over, and came into his own city.
verses.decoded: Jesus got into a boat, crossed over, and arrived in his hometown.

verses.kjv: And, behold, they brought to him a man sick of the palsy, lying on a bed: and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy; Son, be of good cheer; thy sins be forgiven thee.
verses.decoded: Some people brought a paralyzed man lying on a bed to Jesus. Seeing their faith, Jesus said to the man, 'Take heart, your sins are forgiven.'

verses.kjv: And, behold, certain of the scribes said within themselves, This man blasphemeth.
verses.decoded: Some religious teachers thought to themselves, 'This man is blaspheming.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus knowing their thoughts said, Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts?
verses.decoded: Jesus knew what they were thinking and asked, 'Why do you think evil things in your hearts?'

verses.kjv: For whether is easier, to say, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and walk?
verses.decoded: Which is easier to say: 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Get up and walk'?

verses.kjv: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (then saith he to the sick of the palsy,) Arise, take up thy bed, and go unto thine house.
verses.decoded: But to show you that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins, he said to the paralyzed man, 'Get up, take your bed, and go home.'

verses.kjv: And he arose, and departed to his house.
verses.decoded: The man got up and went home.

verses.kjv: But when the multitudes saw it, they marvelled, and glorified God, which had given such power unto men.
verses.decoded: When the crowd saw this, they were amazed and praised God for giving such authority to people.

verses.kjv: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verses.decoded: As Jesus went on, he saw Matthew sitting at his tax collector’s booth and said, 'Follow me.' Matthew got up and followed him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as Jesus sat at meat in the house, behold, many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples.
verses.decoded: Later, while Jesus was eating at a house, many tax collectors and sinners came and ate with him and his followers.

verses.kjv: And when the Pharisees saw it, they said unto his disciples, Why eateth your Master with publicans and sinners?
verses.decoded: When the Pharisees saw this, they asked Jesus’ disciples, 'Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?'

verses.kjv: But when Jesus heard that, he said unto them, They that be whole need not a physician, but they that are sick.
verses.decoded: Jesus heard this and said, 'Healthy people don’t need a doctor—sick people do.'

verses.kjv: But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
verses.decoded: Go and understand what this means: 'I want mercy, not sacrifice.' I didn’t come to call those who think they are righteous, but sinners to change their hearts.

verses.kjv: Then came to him the disciples of John, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft, but thy disciples fast not?
verses.decoded: John’s followers asked Jesus, 'Why do we and the Pharisees fast regularly, but your followers don’t fast?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? but the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken from them, and then shall they fast.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Can the wedding guests mourn while the bridegroom is with them? But the time will come when the bridegroom is taken away, and then they will fast.'

verses.kjv: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.
verses.decoded: No one patches an old piece of clothing with new cloth, because the new patch will shrink and make the tear worse.

verses.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.
verses.decoded: People don’t put new wine into old wine skins because the skins will burst. Instead, new wine is put into new skins so both are kept safe.

verses.kjv: While he spake these things unto them, behold, there came a certain ruler, and worshipped him, saying, My daughter is even now dead: but come and lay thy hand upon her, and she shall live.
verses.decoded: While Jesus was speaking, a man in charge came and respectfully asked him, 'My daughter has just died, but please come and put your hand on her, and she will live.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus arose, and followed him, and so did his disciples.
verses.decoded: Jesus got up and went with the man, and his disciples went with him too.

verses.kjv: And, behold, a woman, which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years, came behind him, and touched the hem of his garment:
verses.decoded: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and touched the edge of his clothes.

verses.kjv: For she said within herself, If I may but touch his garment, I shall be whole.
verses.decoded: She thought to herself, 'If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus turned him about, and when he saw her, he said, Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole. And the woman was made whole from that hour.
verses.decoded: Jesus turned around, saw her, and said, 'Daughter, take heart; your faith has healed you.' And she was healed immediately.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
verses.decoded: When Jesus arrived at the man’s house, he saw musicians and people making a commotion.

verses.kjv: He said unto them, Give place: for the maid is not dead, but sleepeth. And they laughed him to scorn.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'Make way, because the girl is not dead but only sleeping.' They laughed at him.

verses.kjv: But when the people were put forth, he went in, and took her by the hand, and the maid arose.
verses.decoded: After sending the crowd away, Jesus went in, took the girl’s hand, and she got up.

verses.kjv: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
verses.decoded: News about this spread throughout the whole region.

verses.kjv: And when Jesus departed thence, two blind men followed him, crying, and saying, Thou son of David, have mercy on us.
verses.decoded: As Jesus left, two blind men followed him, shouting, 'Son of David, have mercy on us!'

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the house, the blind men came to him: and Jesus saith unto them, Believe ye that I am able to do this? They said unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.decoded: When Jesus entered the house, the blind men came to him, and he asked, 'Do you believe I can heal you?' They answered, 'Yes, Lord.'

verses.kjv: Then touched he their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it unto you.
verses.decoded: Jesus touched their eyes and said, 'Let it happen as you believe.'

verses.kjv: And their eyes were opened; and Jesus straitly charged them, saying, See that no man know it.
verses.decoded: Their eyes were opened, and Jesus warned them strictly, 'Don’t tell anyone.'

verses.kjv: But they, when they were departed, spread abroad his fame in all that country.
verses.decoded: After they left, they spread news about him throughout the whole region.

verses.kjv: As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.
verses.decoded: As they were leaving, some people brought to Jesus a man who was mute and possessed by a demon.

verses.kjv: And when the devil was cast out, the dumb spake: and the multitudes marvelled, saying, It was never so seen in Israel.
verses.decoded: When Jesus cast out the demon, the man who couldn’t speak began to talk. The crowd was amazed and said, 'Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!'

verses.kjv: But the Pharisees said, He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils.
verses.decoded: But the Pharisees said, 'He drives out demons by the power of the prince of demons.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the gospel of the kingdom, and healing every sickness and every disease among the people.
verses.decoded: Jesus traveled through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the good news about God’s kingdom, and healing every kind of sickness and disease among the people.

verses.kjv: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion on them, because they fainted, and were scattered abroad, as sheep having no shepherd.
verses.decoded: When Jesus saw the crowds, he felt deep compassion for them because they were tired and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

verses.kjv: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;
verses.decoded: Then Jesus said to his disciples, 'There is a great harvest of people ready to receive the message, but there are only a few workers to gather them.'

verses.kjv: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
verses.decoded: So pray to the Lord who controls the harvest to send more workers to gather the people.

verses.kjv: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples, he gave them power against unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
verses.decoded: Jesus called his twelve disciples to him and gave them authority over evil spirits to drive them out and to heal every kind of sickness and disease.

verses.kjv: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these; The first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother;
verses.decoded: Here are the names of the twelve apostles: first, Simon, also called Peter, and his brother Andrew; then James, son of Zebedee, and his brother John;

verses.kjv: Philip, and Bartholomew; Thomas, and Matthew the publican; James the son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
verses.decoded: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James, son of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, also called Thaddaeus;

verses.kjv: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
verses.decoded: Simon the Zealot, and Judas Iscariot, the one who later betrayed Jesus.

verses.kjv: These twelve Jesus sent forth, and commanded them, saying, Go not into the way of the Gentiles, and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not:
verses.decoded: Jesus sent out these twelve and instructed them, 'Don’t go to the Gentiles or enter any Samaritan towns.'

verses.kjv: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
verses.decoded: Instead, go to the lost people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand.
verses.decoded: As you go, preach this message: 'The kingdom of heaven is near.'

verses.kjv: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out devils: freely ye have received, freely give.
verses.decoded: Heal the sick, cleanse those with leprosy, raise the dead, and cast out demons. You have received these gifts freely, so freely give them.

verses.kjv: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
verses.decoded: Don’t take gold, silver, or copper coins with you.

verses.kjv: Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.
verses.decoded: Don’t take a bag for your journey, extra clothes, shoes, or a walking stick, because a worker deserves to be supported.

verses.kjv: And into whatsoever city or town ye shall enter, enquire who in it is worthy; and there abide till ye go thence.
verses.decoded: Whenever you enter a town or city, look for someone worthy and stay at their home until you leave.

verses.kjv: And when ye come into an house, salute it.
verses.decoded: When you enter a house, greet the people there.

verses.kjv: And if the house be worthy, let your peace come upon it: but if it be not worthy, let your peace return to you.
verses.decoded: If the house is welcoming, let your peace rest on it; if not, let your peace return to you.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear your words, when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet.
verses.decoded: If anyone refuses to welcome you or listen to your message, leave that house or town and shake the dust off your feet as a warning.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, it will be more bearable for Sodom and Gomorrah on judgment day than for that city.

verses.kjv: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
verses.decoded: Look, I am sending you out like sheep among wolves. So be as clever as snakes and as innocent as doves.

verses.kjv: But beware of men: for they will deliver you up to the councils, and they will scourge you in their synagogues;
verses.decoded: Be careful of people, because they will hand you over to councils and beat you in their synagogues.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony against them and the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: You will be brought before governors and kings because of me, to serve as a witness against them and the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: But when they deliver you up, take no thought how or what ye shall speak: for it shall be given you in that same hour what ye shall speak.
verses.decoded: When you are handed over, don’t worry about what to say or how to say it. At that moment, you will be given the right words.

verses.kjv: For it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you.
verses.decoded: It won’t be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you.

verses.kjv: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death, and the father the child: and the children shall rise up against their parents, and cause them to be put to death.
verses.decoded: Brothers will betray brothers to be killed; fathers will betray their children. Children will rebel against their parents and cause them to be killed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm until the end will be saved.

verses.kjv: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
verses.decoded: If you are persecuted in one city, run to another. I tell you the truth, you won’t finish going through all the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

verses.kjv: The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.
verses.decoded: A student is not greater than the teacher, and a servant is not greater than the master.

verses.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?
verses.decoded: It’s enough for a student to be like their teacher and a servant like their master. If they have insulted the master by calling him Beelzebub, how much more will they insult his followers?

verses.kjv: Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.
verses.decoded: So don’t be afraid of them, because nothing hidden will remain secret forever, and what is concealed will be made known.

verses.kjv: What I tell you in darkness, that speak ye in light: and what ye hear in the ear, that preach ye upon the housetops.
verses.decoded: What I tell you privately, share openly; what you hear quietly, proclaim from the rooftops.

verses.kjv: And fear not them which kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul: but rather fear him which is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.
verses.decoded: Don’t be afraid of those who can kill your body but cannot kill your soul. Instead, fear the one who can destroy both soul and body in hell.

verses.kjv: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father.
verses.decoded: Aren’t two sparrows sold for a very small coin? Yet not one of them falls to the ground without your Father knowing.

verses.kjv: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
verses.decoded: Even the number of hairs on your head is counted.

verses.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.decoded: So don’t be afraid; you are worth much more than many sparrows.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: Anyone who openly acknowledges me before others, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: But anyone who denies me in front of others, I will deny before my Father in heaven.

verses.kjv: Think not that I am come to send peace on earth: I came not to send peace, but a sword.
verses.decoded: Don’t think I came to bring peace on earth; I came to bring division.

verses.kjv: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.decoded: I have come to cause conflict between family members—between a father and son, a daughter and her mother, and a daughter-in-law and her mother-in-law.

verses.kjv: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
verses.decoded: A person’s enemies will be members of their own family.

verses.kjv: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me: and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves their father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; the same goes for anyone who loves their son or daughter more than me.

verses.kjv: And he that taketh not his cross, and followeth after me, is not worthy of me.
verses.decoded: Anyone who does not take up their cross and follow me is not worthy of me.

verses.kjv: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.
verses.decoded: If you try to save your life for yourself, you will lose it; but if you give up your life for me, you will find true life.

verses.kjv: He that receiveth you receiveth me, and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.
verses.decoded: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me, and anyone who welcomes me welcomes the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet’s reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man’s reward.
verses.decoded: Anyone who welcomes a prophet because they are a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward; anyone who welcomes a righteous person because they are righteous will receive a righteous person’s reward.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.
verses.decoded: And anyone who gives even a cup of cold water to one of these little ones because they belong to me will certainly be rewarded.
