verses.kjv: For there are some eunuchs, which were so born from their mother’s womb: and there are some eunuchs, which were made eunuchs of men: and there be eunuchs, which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven’s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
verses.decoded: Some people are born unable to marry, some are made unable by others, and some choose to live this way for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. Whoever can accept this, should.

verses.kjv: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should put his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
verses.decoded: People brought little children to Jesus so he could place his hands on them and pray, but the disciples scolded them.

verses.kjv: But Jesus said, Suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for of such is the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: But Jesus said, 'Let the little children come to me and don’t stop them, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to those like them.'

verses.kjv: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
verses.decoded: He placed his hands on the children and then left that place.

verses.kjv: And, behold, one came and said unto him, Good Master, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
verses.decoded: A man came to Jesus and asked, 'Teacher, what good thing must I do to have eternal life?'

verses.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Why do you call me good? Only God is truly good. But if you want to enter life, obey the commandments.'

verses.kjv: He saith unto him, Which? Jesus said, Thou shalt do no murder, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
verses.decoded: The man asked, 'Which commandments?' Jesus answered, 'Do not murder, do not commit adultery, do not steal, do not lie,'

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.decoded: 'Honor your father and mother, and love your neighbor as yourself.'

verses.kjv: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I kept from my youth up: what lack I yet?
verses.decoded: The young man said, 'I have obeyed all these commandments since I was young. What else do I need?'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him, 'If you want to be perfect, sell your possessions, give the money to the poor, and then come follow me.'

verses.kjv: But when the young man heard that saying, he went away sorrowful: for he had great possessions.
verses.decoded: When the young man heard this, he went away sad because he had many possessions.

verses.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to his disciples, 'I tell you the truth, it is very hard for a rich person to enter the kingdom of heaven.'

verses.kjv: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
verses.decoded: 'I tell you again, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter God's kingdom.'

verses.kjv: When his disciples heard it, they were exceedingly amazed, saying, Who then can be saved?
verses.decoded: The disciples were very surprised and asked, 'If that’s true, then who can be saved?'

verses.kjv: But Jesus beheld them, and said unto them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
verses.decoded: Jesus looked at them and said, 'With people this is impossible, but with God, everything is possible.'

verses.kjv: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore?
verses.decoded: Peter answered, 'Look, we have left everything to follow you. What will we get for that?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'I tell you the truth, when the Son of Man is gloriously seated on his throne in the new age, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.'

verses.kjv: And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has given up homes, family, or land because of me will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.

verses.kjv: But many that are first shall be last; and the last shall be first.
verses.decoded: But many who are first now will be last then, and many who are last now will be first then.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.
verses.decoded: The kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.

verses.kjv: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day, he sent them into his vineyard.
verses.decoded: He agreed to pay the workers a penny for the day and sent them to work in his vineyard.

verses.kjv: And he went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
verses.decoded: About nine o'clock, he went out again and saw others standing around in the marketplace without work.

verses.kjv: And said unto them; Go ye also into the vineyard, and whatsoever is right I will give you. And they went their way.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'Go work in my vineyard too, and I will pay you what is fair.' So they went to work.

verses.kjv: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour, and did likewise.
verses.decoded: He went out again around noon and three o'clock and did the same, hiring more workers.

verses.kjv: And about the eleventh hour he went out, and found others standing idle, and saith unto them, Why stand ye here all the day idle?
verses.decoded: Around five o'clock, he went out once more and found others standing around idle, and asked, 'Why have you been standing here all day doing nothing?'

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Because no man hath hired us. He saith unto them, Go ye also into the vineyard; and whatsoever is right, that shall ye receive.
verses.decoded: They replied, 'Because no one has hired us.' He said, 'Go work in the vineyard too, and I will pay you what is fair.'

verses.kjv: So when even was come, the lord of the vineyard saith unto his steward, Call the labourers, and give them their hire, beginning from the last unto the first.
verses.decoded: At the end of the day, the vineyard owner told his manager to call the workers and pay them, starting with those hired last and ending with those hired first.

verses.kjv: And when they came that were hired about the eleventh hour, they received every man a penny.
verses.decoded: The workers hired at the eleventh hour each received a full day's wage of one penny.

verses.kjv: But when the first came, they supposed that they should have received more; and they likewise received every man a penny.
verses.decoded: When the workers hired first arrived, they expected to get more, but they also received one penny each.

verses.kjv: And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,
verses.decoded: After receiving their pay, they complained against the owner of the vineyard.

verses.kjv: Saying, These last have wrought but one hour, and thou hast made them equal unto us, which have borne the burden and heat of the day.
verses.decoded: They said, 'These workers only worked one hour, yet you have paid them the same as us who worked all day under the hot sun.'

verses.kjv: But he answered one of them, and said, Friend, I do thee no wrong: didst not thou agree with me for a penny?
verses.decoded: The owner replied to one of them, 'Friend, I am not being unfair. Didn't you agree to work for one penny?'

verses.kjv: Take that thine is, and go thy way: I will give unto this last, even as unto thee.
verses.decoded: Take what belongs to you and go. I am free to give the last workers the same as you.

verses.kjv: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own? Is thine eye evil, because I am good?
verses.decoded: Am I not allowed to do what I want with my own money? Are you upset because I am generous?

verses.kjv: So the last shall be first, and the first last: for many be called, but few chosen.
verses.decoded: Those who are last will be first, and those who are first will be last. Many are invited, but only a few are truly chosen.

verses.kjv: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way, and said unto them,
verses.decoded: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside and spoke to them privately.

verses.kjv: Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes, and they shall condemn him to death,
verses.decoded: Look, we are going to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be handed over to the leading priests and teachers, who will condemn him to die.

verses.kjv: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock, and to scourge, and to crucify him: and the third day he shall rise again.
verses.decoded: They will hand him over to the Gentiles, who will mock him, whip him, and crucify him. But on the third day, he will rise again.

verses.kjv: Then came to him the mother of Zebedee’s children with her sons, worshipping him, and desiring a certain thing of him.
verses.decoded: Then the mother of James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus with her sons, showing respect and asking him for a favor.

verses.kjv: And he said unto her, What wilt thou? She saith unto him, Grant that these my two sons may sit, the one on thy right hand, and the other on the left, in thy kingdom.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked her, 'What do you want?' She replied, 'Please let my two sons sit, one at your right side and the other at your left, in your kingdom.'

verses.kjv: But Jesus answered and said, Ye know not what ye ask. Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They say unto him, We are able.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'You don’t understand what you’re asking. Can you endure the suffering I will face?' They answered, 'Yes, we can.'

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Ye shall drink indeed of my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with: but to sit on my right hand, and on my left, is not mine to give, but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared of my Father.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'You will share in my suffering, but the places at my right and left are not for me to give; those are prepared by my Father.'

verses.kjv: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with indignation against the two brethren.
verses.decoded: When the other ten disciples heard this, they became angry with James and John.

verses.kjv: But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them, and they that are great exercise authority upon them.
verses.decoded: Jesus called the disciples to him and said, 'You know that rulers of the Gentiles control their people and that those in power boss them around.'

verses.kjv: But it shall not be so among you: but whosoever will be great among you, let him be your minister;
verses.decoded: But it will be different with you. Whoever wants to be great among you must become a servant.

verses.kjv: And whosoever will be chief among you, let him be your servant:
verses.decoded: And whoever wants to be first must be your slave.

verses.kjv: Even as the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.
verses.decoded: Just as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve others and to give his life to save many.

verses.kjv: And as they departed from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.
verses.decoded: As Jesus and the disciples left Jericho, a large crowd followed him.

verses.kjv: And, behold, two blind men sitting by the way side, when they heard that Jesus passed by, cried out, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.decoded: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside. When they heard Jesus was passing by, they shouted, 'Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!'

verses.kjv: And the multitude rebuked them, because they should hold their peace: but they cried the more, saying, Have mercy on us, O Lord, thou son of David.
verses.decoded: The crowd told them to be quiet, but they shouted even louder, saying, 'Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!'

verses.kjv: And Jesus stood still, and called them, and said, What will ye that I shall do unto you?
verses.decoded: Jesus stopped, called them over, and asked, 'What do you want me to do for you?'

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.
verses.decoded: They answered, 'Lord, please let us see again.'

verses.kjv: So Jesus had compassion on them, and touched their eyes: and immediately their eyes received sight, and they followed him.
verses.decoded: Jesus felt sorry for them, touched their eyes, and immediately they could see. Then they followed him.

verses.kjv: And when they drew nigh unto Jerusalem, and were come to Bethphage, unto the mount of Olives, then sent Jesus two disciples,
verses.decoded: As they approached Jerusalem and reached Bethphage near the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples ahead.

verses.kjv: Saying unto them, Go into the village over against you, and straightway ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her: loose them, and bring them unto me.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'Go into the village across from you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied up with her colt. Untie them and bring them to me.'

verses.kjv: And if any man say ought unto you, ye shall say, The Lord hath need of them; and straightway he will send them.
verses.decoded: If anyone asks why you are taking them, say, 'The Lord needs them,' and they will let you go at once.

verses.kjv: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying,
verses.decoded: Everything happened this way to fulfill what the prophet had spoken.

verses.kjv: Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.decoded: Tell the people of Zion, 'Look, your King is coming to you, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the young foal of a donkey.'

verses.kjv: And the disciples went, and did as Jesus commanded them,
verses.decoded: The disciples went and did exactly as Jesus had told them.

verses.kjv: And brought the ass, and the colt, and put on them their clothes, and they set him thereon.
verses.decoded: They brought the donkey and colt, placed their cloaks on them, and Jesus sat on them.

verses.kjv: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way; others cut down branches from the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verses.decoded: A large crowd spread their clothes on the road, while others cut branches from trees and laid them down.

verses.kjv: And the multitudes that went before, and that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord; Hosanna in the highest.
verses.decoded: The crowds in front and behind shouted, 'Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!'

verses.kjv: And when he was come into Jerusalem, all the city was moved, saying, Who is this?
verses.decoded: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, 'Who is this?'

verses.kjv: And the multitude said, This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee.
verses.decoded: The crowd answered, 'This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.'

verses.kjv: And Jesus went into the temple of God, and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves,
verses.decoded: Jesus entered the temple and drove out everyone who was buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.

verses.kjv: And said unto them, It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but ye have made it a den of thieves.
verses.decoded: He told them, 'It is written, My house will be called a house of prayer, but you have turned it into a den of thieves.'

verses.kjv: And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.
verses.decoded: The blind and lame came to Jesus in the temple, and he healed them.

verses.kjv: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children crying in the temple, and saying, Hosanna to the son of David; they were sore displeased,
verses.decoded: When the chief priests and teachers of the law saw the amazing things Jesus did and heard the children shouting, 'Hosanna to the Son of David,' they became very angry.

verses.kjv: And said unto him, Hearest thou what these say? And Jesus saith unto them, Yea; have ye never read, Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise?
verses.decoded: He asked Jesus, 'Do you hear what these children are saying?' Jesus replied, 'Yes, haven’t you ever read that praise comes perfectly even from the mouths of little children?'

verses.kjv: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he stayed overnight.

verses.kjv: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
verses.decoded: The next morning, as Jesus was returning to the city, He felt hungry.

verses.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.
verses.decoded: Seeing a fig tree on the road, He went to it but found only leaves and no fruit. He said to it, 'May you never bear fruit again!' Immediately, the fig tree withered.

verses.kjv: And when the disciples saw it, they marvelled, saying, How soon is the fig tree withered away!
verses.decoded: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed and said, 'How quickly the fig tree has withered!'

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, If ye have faith, and doubt not, ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree, but also if ye shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; it shall be done.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'Truly, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you can do not only what happened to the fig tree, but also say to a mountain, “Move and throw yourself into the sea,” and it will happen.'

verses.kjv: And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.
verses.decoded: Whatever you ask for in prayer, believing, you will receive.

verses.kjv: And when he was come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority?
verses.decoded: When Jesus entered the temple and was teaching, the chief priests and elders came to Him and asked, 'By what authority are you doing these things? Who gave you this authority?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I also will ask you one thing, which if ye tell me, I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things.
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'I will ask you one question, and if you answer it, I will tell you by what authority I do these things.'

verses.kjv: The baptism of John, whence was it? from heaven, or of men? And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say unto us, Why did ye not then believe him?
verses.decoded: He asked, 'Was John’s baptism from heaven or from human authority?' They thought to themselves, 'If we say it was from heaven, Jesus will ask why we didn’t believe John.'

verses.kjv: But if we shall say, Of men; we fear the people; for all hold John as a prophet.
verses.decoded: But if we say it was from human authority, we fear the people, because everyone regards John as a prophet.

verses.kjv: And they answered Jesus, and said, We cannot tell. And he said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
verses.decoded: They answered Jesus, 'We don’t know.' Jesus replied, 'Then I won’t tell you by what authority I do these things either.'

verses.kjv: But what think ye? A certain man had two sons; and he came to the first, and said, Son, go work to day in my vineyard.
verses.decoded: Jesus asked, 'What do you think? A man had two sons. He went to the first and said, “Son, go work in my vineyard today.”'

verses.kjv: He answered and said, I will not: but afterward he repented, and went.
verses.decoded: The son answered, 'I will not,' but later changed his mind and went.

verses.kjv: And he came to the second, and said likewise. And he answered and said, I go, sir: and went not.
verses.decoded: The man then went to the second son and said the same thing. The second son said, 'I will go, sir,' but he didn’t go.

verses.kjv: Whether of them twain did the will of his father? They say unto him, The first. Jesus saith unto them, Verily I say unto you, That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you.
verses.decoded: Which of the two did what their father wanted? They answered, The first one. Jesus said to them, Truly I tell you, that tax collectors and prostitutes will enter the kingdom of God before you.

verses.kjv: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness, and ye believed him not: but the publicans and the harlots believed him: and ye, when ye had seen it, repented not afterward, that ye might believe him.
verses.decoded: John came to you, showing the right way to live, but you did not believe him. However, tax collectors and prostitutes believed him. Even after seeing this, you did not repent and believe him.

verses.kjv: Hear another parable: There was a certain householder, which planted a vineyard, and hedged it round about, and digged a winepress in it, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country:
verses.decoded: Listen to another story: A man planted a vineyard, surrounded it with a fence, dug a winepress, built a watchtower, then rented it to farmers and went away to another country.

verses.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
verses.decoded: When it was time to collect the fruit, he sent his servants to the farmers to get his share of the harvest.

verses.kjv: And the husbandmen took his servants, and beat one, and killed another, and stoned another.
verses.decoded: But the farmers grabbed his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.

verses.kjv: Again, he sent other servants more than the first: and they did unto them likewise.
verses.decoded: He sent more servants than before, but the farmers treated them the same way.

verses.kjv: But last of all he sent unto them his son, saying, They will reverence my son.
verses.decoded: Finally, he sent his son, thinking they would respect him.

verses.kjv: But when the husbandmen saw the son, they said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and let us seize on his inheritance.
verses.decoded: But when the farmers saw the son, they said to each other, This is the heir. Let’s kill him and take his inheritance.

verses.kjv: And they caught him, and cast him out of the vineyard, and slew him.
verses.decoded: So they grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

verses.kjv: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh, what will he do unto those husbandmen?
verses.decoded: So when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?

verses.kjv: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.
verses.decoded: They answered, He will destroy those wicked men and rent the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit at the right time.

verses.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, Did ye never read in the scriptures, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner: this is the Lord’s doing, and it is marvellous in our eyes?
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, Haven’t you read in the Scriptures: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone? This is the Lord’s doing, and it is amazing to us.

verses.kjv: Therefore say I unto you, The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof.
verses.decoded: So I tell you, the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruits.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
verses.decoded: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will be broken, but anyone the stone falls on will be crushed.

verses.kjv: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables, they perceived that he spake of them.
verses.decoded: When the chief priests and Pharisees heard his stories, they realized he was talking about them.

verses.kjv: But when they sought to lay hands on him, they feared the multitude, because they took him for a prophet.
verses.decoded: When they tried to arrest Jesus, they were afraid of the crowd because the people believed he was a prophet.

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and spake unto them again by parables, and said,
verses.decoded: The kingdom of heaven is like a king who arranged a wedding for his son,

verses.kjv: The kingdom of heaven is like unto a certain king, which made a marriage for his son,
verses.decoded: He sent his servants to invite those who were invited to the wedding, but they refused to come.

verses.kjv: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.
verses.decoded: He sent more servants, saying, 'Tell those invited, I have prepared the feast; my oxen and fattened cattle are ready. Come to the wedding!'

verses.kjv: Again, he sent forth other servants, saying, Tell them which are bidden, Behold, I have prepared my dinner: my oxen and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready: come unto the marriage.
verses.decoded: But they ignored the invitation and went about their own business—one to his farm, another to his trade.

verses.kjv: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:
verses.decoded: Some even mistreated and killed the king’s servants.

verses.kjv: And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.
verses.decoded: When the king heard this, he was angry. He sent his army, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

verses.kjv: But when the king heard thereof, he was wroth: and he sent forth his armies, and destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.
verses.decoded: Then he told his servants, 'The wedding is ready, but those invited were not worthy.'

verses.kjv: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
verses.decoded: Go to the streets and invite everyone you find to the wedding.

verses.kjv: Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.
verses.decoded: The servants went out, gathered everyone they could find—both bad and good—and the wedding hall was filled with guests.

verses.kjv: So those servants went out into the highways, and gathered together all as many as they found, both bad and good: and the wedding was furnished with guests.
verses.decoded: When the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man who wasn’t wearing a wedding garment.

verses.kjv: And when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment:
verses.decoded: The king asked him, 'Friend, how did you get in here without a wedding garment?' The man had no answer.

verses.kjv: And he saith unto him, Friend, how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment? And he was speechless.
verses.decoded: Then the king told the servants, 'Tie him up and throw him outside into the darkness, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.'

verses.kjv: Then said the king to the servants, Bind him hand and foot, and take him away, and cast him into outer darkness; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.decoded: Many are invited, but only a few are truly accepted.

verses.kjv: For many are called, but few are chosen.
verses.decoded: Then the Pharisees met to plan how to trap Jesus with his own words.

verses.kjv: Then went the Pharisees, and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk.
verses.decoded: They sent their disciples along with the Herodians to ask Jesus, 'Teacher, we know you speak the truth and teach God’s way honestly. You don’t worry about what people think because you don’t favor anyone.'

verses.kjv: And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, Master, we know that thou art true, and teachest the way of God in truth, neither carest thou for any man: for thou regardest not the person of men.
verses.decoded: So tell us, what do you think? Is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?

verses.kjv: Tell us therefore, What thinkest thou? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar, or not?
verses.decoded: But Jesus knew their evil intentions and said, Why are you trying to trap me, you hypocrites?

verses.kjv: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why tempt ye me, ye hypocrites?
verses.decoded: Show me the coin used for paying the tax. They brought him a Roman coin.

verses.kjv: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
verses.decoded: He asked them, Whose picture and inscription are on this coin?

verses.kjv: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
verses.decoded: They replied, Caesar's. Then Jesus said, Give back to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God.

verses.kjv: They say unto him, Caesar’s. Then saith he unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar’s; and unto God the things that are God’s.
verses.decoded: When they heard this, they were amazed, left him, and went away.

verses.kjv: When they had heard these words, they marvelled, and left him, and went their way.
verses.decoded: That same day, the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him and asked,

verses.kjv: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
verses.decoded: They said, Teacher, Moses said that if a man dies without children, his brother should marry the widow to have children for him.

verses.kjv: Saying, Master, Moses said, If a man die, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
verses.decoded: There were seven brothers. The first married a woman and died without children, so he left his wife to his brother.

verses.kjv: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
verses.decoded: The same happened with the second, third, up to the seventh brother.

verses.kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
verses.decoded: Finally, the woman also died.

verses.kjv: And last of all the woman died also.
verses.decoded: So at the resurrection, whose wife will she be since she was married to all seven?

verses.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, You are mistaken because you don’t understand the Scriptures or the power of God.

verses.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto them, Ye do err, not knowing the scriptures, nor the power of God.
verses.decoded: At the resurrection, people will not marry or be married; they will be like the angels in heaven.

verses.kjv: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven.
verses.decoded: As for the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read what God said to you,

verses.kjv: But as touching the resurrection of the dead, have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God, saying,
verses.decoded: God said, 'I am the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' He is not the God of those who have died, but of those who are alive.

verses.kjv: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.
verses.decoded: When the crowd heard this, they were amazed at his teaching.

verses.kjv: And when the multitude heard this, they were astonished at his doctrine.
verses.decoded: When the Pharisees learned that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.

verses.kjv: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.decoded: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked Jesus a question to test Him, saying,

verses.kjv: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.decoded: Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?

verses.kjv: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.decoded: Jesus replied, 'Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.'

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.
verses.decoded: This is the first and most important commandment.

verses.kjv: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.decoded: The second is like it: Love your neighbor as yourself.

verses.kjv: And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.decoded: All the law and the teachings of the prophets depend on these two commandments.

verses.kjv: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.decoded: While the Pharisees were gathered, Jesus asked them,

verses.kjv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
verses.decoded: He asked, 'What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he?' They answered, 'He is the son of David.'

verses.kjv: Saying, What think ye of Christ? whose son is he? They say unto him, The son of David.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, 'Then how does David, speaking by the Spirit, call him Lord, saying,'

verses.kjv: He saith unto them, How then doth David in spirit call him Lord, saying,
verses.decoded: 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet?'

verses.kjv: The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand, till I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.decoded: If David calls him 'Lord,' how can he be his son?

verses.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?
verses.decoded: No one could answer him, and from that day on, no one dared to ask him any more questions.

verses.kjv: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.decoded: Then Jesus spoke to the crowd and to his followers,

verses.kjv: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
verses.decoded: He said, The teachers of the law and the Pharisees are in positions of authority, like sitting in Moses' place,

verses.kjv: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not ye after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.decoded: So do everything they tell you to do, but don’t follow their example, because they say one thing but do another.

verses.kjv: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.decoded: They put heavy, difficult rules on people’s shoulders, but they themselves won’t lift a finger to help.

verses.kjv: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.decoded: They do everything to be noticed by others: they make their prayer boxes bigger and their clothing edges wider,

verses.kjv: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.decoded: They love to sit in the best seats at banquets and in the front seats in the synagogues,

verses.kjv: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.decoded: They enjoy being greeted respectfully in public places and being called ‘Teacher, Teacher.’

verses.kjv: But be not ye called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all ye are brethren.
verses.decoded: But don’t let yourselves be called ‘Teacher,’ because you have only one Teacher—the Messiah—and you are all equal as brothers.

verses.kjv: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.decoded: Don’t call anyone ‘father’ as a spiritual authority, because your only Father is God in heaven.

verses.kjv: Neither be ye called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ.
verses.decoded: Don’t call anyone ‘leader’ or ‘master,’ because Christ alone is your Master.

verses.kjv: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.decoded: The greatest person among you must be the one who serves others.

verses.kjv: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: Anyone who tries to lift themselves up will be brought down, but anyone who humbles themselves will be lifted up.

verses.kjv: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for ye neither go in yourselves, neither suffer ye them that are entering to go in.
verses.decoded: But you teachers and Pharisees, you hypocrites, you block people from entering God’s kingdom—you don’t enter yourselves, and you stop others from entering.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.decoded: Woe to you teachers and Pharisees, hypocrites! You take advantage of widows and pretend to be holy by praying long prayers. Because of this, you will be punished more severely.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.decoded: Woe to you teachers and Pharisees, hypocrites! You travel everywhere to convert one person, but once they become a follower, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, ye blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.decoded: How terrible for you, blind leaders! You say that if someone swears by the temple, it means nothing, but if they swear by the gold in the temple, they are obligated.

verses.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.decoded: You fools and blind people! Which is greater: the gold or the temple that makes the gold holy?

verses.kjv: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.decoded: You say that swearing by the altar means nothing, but swearing by the gift on the altar makes a person responsible.

verses.kjv: Ye fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.decoded: You fools and blind people! Which is greater: the gift or the altar that makes the gift holy?

verses.kjv: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, sweareth by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.decoded: Anyone who swears by the altar is really swearing by the altar and everything on it.

verses.kjv: And whoso shall swear by the temple, sweareth by it, and by him that dwelleth therein.
verses.decoded: Anyone who swears by the temple is swearing by the temple and by God who lives there.

verses.kjv: And he that shall swear by heaven, sweareth by the throne of God, and by him that sitteth thereon.
verses.decoded: Anyone who swears by heaven is swearing by God's throne and by God himself who sits there.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.decoded: How terrible for you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, hypocrites! You carefully give a tenth of even the smallest herbs, but you neglect the more important things of the law—justice, mercy, and faithfulness. You should do these things without neglecting the others.

verses.kjv: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.decoded: You blind leaders! You strain out a tiny gnat but swallow a huge camel.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.decoded: How terrible for you, teachers and Pharisees, hypocrites! You clean the outside of cups and plates, but inside you are full of greed and self-indulgence.

verses.kjv: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.decoded: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and plate, so the outside will also be clean.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.decoded: How terrible for you, teachers and Pharisees, hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs that look beautiful on the outside but inside are full of dead bones and everything unclean.

verses.kjv: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.decoded: In the same way, you appear righteous to others on the outside, but inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.

verses.kjv: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because ye build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.decoded: How terrible for you, teachers and Pharisees, hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous,

verses.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.decoded: and say, ‘If we had lived in the time of our ancestors, we would not have joined them in killing the prophets.’

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves, that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.decoded: You prove yourselves to be the children of those who killed the prophets.

verses.kjv: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.decoded: So go ahead and complete the sins of your ancestors.

verses.kjv: Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?
verses.decoded: You snakes, you brood of vipers, how can you escape the punishment of hell?

verses.kjv: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them ye shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.decoded: Therefore, I am sending prophets, wise people, and teachers to you. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will whip in your synagogues and chase from town to town.

verses.kjv: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.decoded: So that all the innocent blood spilled on earth—from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the temple and the altar—will come upon you.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.decoded: Truly, I tell you, all these things will happen to this generation.

verses.kjv: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, thou that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto thee, how often would I have gathered thy children together, even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings, and ye would not!
verses.decoded: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I wanted to gather your children together like a mother hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you refused!

verses.kjv: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.decoded: Look, your temple is left empty and abandoned.

verses.kjv: For I say unto you, Ye shall not see me henceforth, till ye shall say, Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord.’

verses.kjv: And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.decoded: Jesus left the temple, and his disciples came to him to show him the temple buildings.

verses.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, See ye not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.decoded: Jesus said, 'Do you see all these buildings? I tell you, not one stone will be left on another; everything will be destroyed.'

verses.kjv: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.decoded: While sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples asked Jesus privately, 'When will these things happen? What will be the sign of your coming and the end of the age?'

verses.kjv: And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'Be careful that no one deceives you.'

verses.kjv: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.
verses.decoded: Many will come claiming to be the Messiah and will deceive many people.

verses.kjv: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.decoded: You will hear about wars and rumors of wars. Don’t be alarmed, because these things must happen first, but the end is not yet.

verses.kjv: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.decoded: Nations will fight against each other, kingdoms against kingdoms. There will be famines, diseases, and earthquakes in various places.

verses.kjv: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.decoded: All these events are just the beginning of difficult times.

verses.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
verses.decoded: Then people will hand you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.

verses.kjv: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.decoded: Many will turn away from faith, betray each other, and hate one another.

verses.kjv: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.decoded: Many false teachers will appear and deceive many people.

verses.kjv: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.decoded: Because evil will increase, the love of many will grow cold.

verses.kjv: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.decoded: But the one who remains faithful until the end will be saved.

verses.kjv: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.decoded: The good news about God’s kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.

verses.kjv: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.decoded: So when you see the 'abomination that causes desolation' spoken about by the prophet Daniel standing in the holy place, let the reader understand.

verses.kjv: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.decoded: Those who are in Judea should run away to the mountains.

verses.kjv: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.decoded: If someone is on the roof, they should not go back inside to get anything.

verses.kjv: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.decoded: If someone is working in the field, they should not go back home to get their clothes.

verses.kjv: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.decoded: It will be especially hard for pregnant women and mothers with nursing babies during those days.

verses.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.decoded: Pray that your escape won't have to happen in winter or on the Sabbath.

verses.kjv: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.decoded: There will be terrible suffering like nothing the world has ever seen before or will ever see again.

verses.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.decoded: If those days were not cut short, no one would survive; but for the sake of God's chosen people, those days will be shortened.

verses.kjv: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.
verses.decoded: If anyone tells you 'Look, the Christ is here' or 'He is there,' don't believe it.

verses.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.decoded: False messiahs and prophets will appear and perform amazing signs and miracles, trying to deceive even God's chosen people if possible.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.decoded: I have warned you about this ahead of time.

verses.kjv: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
verses.decoded: So if anyone says, 'Look, he is in the wilderness,' don't go out to see him; or 'Look, he is in a private room,' don't believe it.

verses.kjv: For as the lightning cometh out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.decoded: Just as lightning flashes from the east to the west, the coming of the Son of Man will be visible and unmistakable everywhere.

verses.kjv: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.decoded: Wherever there is a dead body, vultures will gather.

verses.kjv: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.decoded: Right after the terrible suffering of those days, the sun will go dark, the moon will stop shining, stars will fall from the sky, and the forces of heaven will be shaken.

verses.kjv: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.decoded: Then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky, all people on earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds with great power and glory.

verses.kjv: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.decoded: He will send his angels with a loud trumpet blast, and they will gather his chosen ones from all directions, from one end of the sky to the other.

verses.kjv: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is nigh:
verses.decoded: Learn a lesson from the fig tree: when its branches become soft and it starts to grow leaves, you know summer is near.

verses.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
verses.decoded: In the same way, when you see all these signs, understand that the event is near—right at the door.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.decoded: Truly, I tell you, this generation will not disappear until all these things happen.

verses.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.decoded: Heaven and earth will disappear, but my words will never disappear.

verses.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.decoded: But no one knows the exact day or hour—not even the angels in heaven—only my Father knows.

verses.kjv: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.decoded: Just as it was in Noah’s time, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

verses.kjv: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.decoded: In those days before the flood, people were eating, drinking, getting married, and giving in marriage, right up until the day Noah entered the ark.

verses.kjv: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.
verses.decoded: They didn’t realize what was coming until the flood swept them all away. The coming of the Son of Man will be like that.

verses.kjv: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.decoded: Two people will be working in the field; one will be taken away, and the other left behind.

verses.kjv: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.decoded: Two women will be grinding grain at the mill; one will be taken, and the other left behind.

verses.kjv: Watch therefore: for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.
verses.decoded: So stay alert, because you don’t know when your Lord will come.

verses.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.decoded: Remember, if the homeowner had known when the thief was coming, he would have stayed awake and protected his house.

verses.kjv: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
verses.decoded: So be ready too, because the Son of Man will come at a time you don’t expect.

verses.kjv: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord hath made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.decoded: Who is the faithful and wise servant that the master puts in charge of the household to give the right food at the right time?

verses.kjv: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.decoded: Happy is the servant whom his master finds doing his duty when he returns.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.decoded: Truly, I tell you, the master will put that servant in charge of all his possessions.

verses.kjv: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.decoded: But if that wicked servant thinks to himself, 'My master is taking a long time to come,'

verses.kjv: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.decoded: and starts mistreating his fellow servants and partying with drunkards;

verses.kjv: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.decoded: the master will come on a day the servant does not expect, at an hour he is unaware of,

verses.kjv: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.decoded: and will punish him severely, assigning him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

verses.kjv: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.decoded: The kingdom of heaven will be like ten young women who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

verses.kjv: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.decoded: Five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

verses.kjv: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.decoded: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not bring any extra oil with them.

verses.kjv: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.decoded: But the wise took extra oil in containers along with their lamps.

verses.kjv: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.decoded: While they waited for the bridegroom, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.

verses.kjv: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.decoded: At midnight, a shout rang out: 'Look, the bridegroom is coming! Go out to meet him!'

verses.kjv: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.decoded: Then all the young women got up and prepared their lamps.

verses.kjv: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.decoded: The foolish ones said to the wise, 'Give us some of your oil because our lamps are going out.'

verses.kjv: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.decoded: But the wise replied, 'No, because there might not be enough for both you and us. Instead, go buy some for yourselves.'

verses.kjv: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.decoded: While they went to buy oil, the bridegroom arrived. Those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was closed.

verses.kjv: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.decoded: Later, the other young women came and said, 'Lord, Lord, open the door for us!'

verses.kjv: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.decoded: But he answered, 'Truly, I tell you, I do not know you.'

verses.kjv: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.decoded: So be ready, because you do not know the day or the hour when the Son of Man will come.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.decoded: The kingdom of heaven is like a man going on a journey to a distant country. He called his servants and gave them his property.

verses.kjv: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.decoded: He gave one servant five talents, another two, and another one—each according to their ability—and then he left on his journey.

verses.kjv: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.decoded: The man who received five talents went and used them to trade, and earned five more talents.

verses.kjv: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.decoded: Similarly, the man who received two talents earned two more.

verses.kjv: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.decoded: But the man who received one talent dug a hole in the ground and hid his master's money.

verses.kjv: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.decoded: After a long time, the master returned and settled accounts with his servants.

verses.kjv: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.decoded: The man with five talents came and gave back five more, saying, 'Master, you gave me five talents; see, I have earned five more.'

verses.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.decoded: His master said, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been trustworthy with little; I will put you in charge of much. Come share in your master's happiness.'

verses.kjv: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.decoded: The man with two talents also came and said, 'Master, you gave me two talents; see, I have earned two more.'

verses.kjv: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.decoded: His master said, 'Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been trustworthy with little; I will put you in charge of much. Come share in your master's happiness.'

verses.kjv: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.decoded: Then the man who had received one talent came and said, 'Master, I knew you were a hard man, harvesting where you did not plant and gathering where you did not scatter seed.'

verses.kjv: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
verses.decoded: So I was afraid and hid your talent in the ground. Here it is back.

verses.kjv: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.decoded: His master replied, 'You wicked and lazy servant! You knew I harvest where I have not planted and gather where I have not scattered seed.'

verses.kjv: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.decoded: You should have at least put my money with the bankers, so that when I returned, I would have received it back with interest.

verses.kjv: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.decoded: Take the talent away from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.

verses.kjv: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.decoded: For whoever has will be given more and will have an abundance. But whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken away.

verses.kjv: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.decoded: Throw that worthless servant outside into the darkness, where there will be weeping and grinding of teeth.

verses.kjv: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.decoded: When the Son of Man comes in his glory, accompanied by all his holy angels, he will sit on his glorious throne.

verses.kjv: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
verses.decoded: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate people from one another like a shepherd separates sheep from goats.

verses.kjv: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.decoded: He will place the sheep on his right side and the goats on his left.

verses.kjv: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.decoded: Then the King will say to those on his right, 'Come, you who are blessed by my Father; receive the kingdom prepared for you since the world was created.'

verses.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.decoded: I was hungry and you gave me food; I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink; I was a stranger and you welcomed me.

verses.kjv: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.decoded: I was naked and you gave me clothes; I was sick and you cared for me; I was in prison and you visited me.

verses.kjv: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
verses.decoded: Then the righteous will ask him, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?'

verses.kjv: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
verses.decoded: When did we see you as a stranger and welcome you, or naked and give you clothes?

verses.kjv: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.decoded: Or when did we see you sick or in prison and visit you?

verses.kjv: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verses.decoded: The King will answer, 'Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.'

verses.kjv: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.decoded: Then he will say to those on his left, 'Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.'

verses.kjv: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.decoded: I was hungry and you gave me no food; I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink.

verses.kjv: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.decoded: I was a stranger and you did not welcome me; naked and you did not give me clothes; sick and in prison and you did not visit me.

verses.kjv: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.decoded: Then they will also ask, 'Lord, when did we see you hungry, thirsty, a stranger, naked, sick, or in prison and not help you?'

verses.kjv: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
verses.decoded: He will reply, 'Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.'

verses.kjv: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.decoded: And those people will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous will go to eternal life.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.decoded: After Jesus finished saying all these things, he spoke to his disciples,

verses.kjv: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.decoded: You know that in two days the Passover feast will begin, and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.

verses.kjv: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.decoded: Then the chief priests, teachers of the law, and elders gathered at the high priest Caiaphas’s house,

verses.kjv: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.decoded: and they discussed how to secretly arrest Jesus and kill him.

verses.kjv: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.decoded: But they decided not to do it during the festival, to avoid causing an uproar among the people.

verses.kjv: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.decoded: At that time, Jesus was in Bethany, at the home of Simon, who had been a leper,

verses.kjv: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.decoded: A woman came to him with a jar of expensive perfume and poured it on his head while he was eating.

verses.kjv: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.decoded: When the disciples saw this, they were upset and said, 'Why waste this perfume?'

verses.kjv: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.decoded: They said it could have been sold for a lot of money and the money given to the poor.

verses.kjv: When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble ye the woman? for she hath wrought a good work upon me.
verses.decoded: Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, 'Why bother the woman? She has done a good thing for me.'

verses.kjv: For ye have the poor always with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.decoded: You will always have the poor with you, but you won’t always have me.

verses.kjv: For in that she hath poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.decoded: By pouring this perfume on my body, she is preparing me for burial.

verses.kjv: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman hath done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.decoded: I tell you the truth, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will be remembered and told in her honor.

verses.kjv: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.decoded: Then one of the twelve disciples, Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

verses.kjv: And said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.decoded: and asked them, 'What will you give me if I hand him over to you?' They agreed to pay him thirty pieces of silver.

verses.kjv: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.decoded: From that moment on, he looked for a chance to betray Jesus.

verses.kjv: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover?
verses.decoded: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the disciples asked Jesus, 'Where do you want us to prepare the Passover meal for you?'

verses.kjv: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master saith, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples.
verses.decoded: Jesus told them, 'Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, The Teacher says, My time is near; I will celebrate the Passover at your house with my disciples.'

verses.kjv: And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.decoded: The disciples did as Jesus instructed and prepared the Passover meal.

verses.kjv: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.decoded: In the evening, Jesus sat down with the twelve disciples.

verses.kjv: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.decoded: While they were eating, Jesus said, 'Truly, I tell you, one of you will betray me.'

verses.kjv: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.decoded: They were very sad and each one asked Jesus, 'Lord, is it me?'

verses.kjv: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.decoded: Jesus answered, 'The one who dips his hand with me in the dish will betray me.'

verses.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.decoded: The Son of Man will go as the Scriptures say, but terrible punishment awaits the one who betrays him—it would have been better if he had never been born.

verses.kjv: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, Thou hast said.
verses.decoded: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, asked, 'Teacher, is it me?' Jesus replied, 'You have said it.'

verses.kjv: And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.decoded: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks, broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, 'Take and eat; this is my body.'

verses.kjv: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink ye all of it;
verses.decoded: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, 'Drink from it, all of you.'

verses.kjv: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.decoded: This is my blood of the new covenant, poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.

verses.kjv: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
verses.decoded: But I tell you, I will not drink this wine again until the day I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom.

verses.kjv: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.decoded: After singing a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

verses.kjv: Then saith Jesus unto them, All ye shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.decoded: Jesus said to them, "Tonight, all of you will fall away because of me. It is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'"

verses.kjv: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.decoded: But after I rise from the dead, I will go ahead of you to Galilee.

verses.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.
verses.decoded: Peter replied, "Even if everyone else falls away because of you, I will never fall away."

verses.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, That this night, before the cock crow, thou shalt deny me thrice.
verses.decoded: Jesus told him, "I assure you, before the rooster crows tonight, you will deny me three times."

verses.kjv: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with thee, yet will I not deny thee. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.decoded: Peter said, "Even if I have to die with you, I will never deny you." All the disciples said the same.

verses.kjv: Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.decoded: Then Jesus went with them to a place called Gethsemane and said to the disciples, "Sit here while I go over there to pray."

verses.kjv: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.decoded: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee with him and began to feel deeply sad and troubled.

verses.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
verses.decoded: He went a little farther, knelt down, and prayed, "My Father, if it is possible, let this suffering pass from me. But not what I want, but what you want."

verses.kjv: And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.
verses.decoded: He returned to the disciples and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, "Couldn't you stay awake and keep watch with me for one hour?"

verses.kjv: And he cometh unto the disciples, and findeth them asleep, and saith unto Peter, What, could ye not watch with me one hour?
verses.decoded: Stay awake and pray so you don’t fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the body is weak.

verses.kjv: Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.decoded: He went away a second time and prayed, "My Father, if I cannot avoid this suffering unless I endure it, then let your will be done."

verses.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.
verses.decoded: He came back and found them sleeping again because their eyes were heavy.

verses.kjv: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.decoded: He left them and went away a third time, praying the same prayer.

verses.kjv: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.decoded: Then he returned to the disciples and said, "Go ahead and sleep now and get some rest. The time has come; the Son of Man is about to be betrayed into the hands of sinners."
